restated: An adversary with existing access to Windows hosts on this network harvested credentials from those hosts.
what_would_confirm: LSASS memory access or dumping (e.g., procdump, comsvcs.dll MiniDump, Mimikatz), SAM/SECURITY hive or NTDS.dit extraction, credential-store or DPAPI access, Kerberoasting/AS-REP roasting, or suspicious access to lsass.exe by non-standard processes.
what_would_refute: No evidence of credential-dumping tooling, no anomalous lsass.exe access, no registry hive or credential-store extraction, and no Kerberos ticket-request anomalies on the affected hosts.
